item.title: The War Will Be Decided on the Battlefield, Not at the Table
item.description: Why this war has a military solution and not a diplomatic one — and why the only honest road to peace runs through arming Ukraine, exhausting Russia's war machine, and carrying the fight to military targets on Russian soil.
